Definition: properly, something dangling, i.e. a loose thread or hair; figuratively, indigent
BiblicalUsage: 1) hair, threads, thrum (threads of warp hanging in loom); 2) poor (usually coll of helpless people); 3)(TWOT) poorest, lowest
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
